cause_quote: The new tab strip set `ariaControls: "chat-side-panel-content"` for every tab, and every pane rendered its side-panel body with `id="chat-side-panel-content"`.
user_saw: Assistive technology could associate a tab with content in the wrong pane or miss the Chat content after a swap.
summary: The fix gives Chat and tool content stable, pane-specific region IDs, points each tab at its own region, and keeps close-tab focus recovery within the correct tab group.
reasoning: Split chat panes already existed when the unified side-panel tab strip introduced a shared target ID that each pane duplicated. I checked the introducing diff and the later swap diff, which added Chat to the side-tab flow while keeping its content outside the shared target.
